Performers
American Symphony Orchestra (orchestra) Documented

Conductor unknown. This historical recording ensemble is not identified with Leopold Stokowski’s orchestra founded in 1962.

[2] [1]
Work version
Orchestral concert excerpt from the opening of Act III Documented

No singers are credited. The acoustic-recording arrangement, exact cuts and instrumental substitutions are not documented; a full-opera orchestration timeline is therefore withheld.

Matrix, take, sides
7846-B-1-6; catalogue side 80638-R Documented

The institution’s complete matrix string is preserved without attempting to decode its suffixes.

[2]
Transfer
National Park Service digitisation; Adam Cuerden, Commons noise reduction and equalisation Documented

NPS is the institutional source, not a named engineer. The current Commons version restores Adam Cuerden’s processing after a later alternative edit.

[2] [1]
Transfer date
2009-10-10 (Commons processed version) Documented

This is the upload date of the documented processed version, not the date of the original NPS digitisation; the current-file revision is dated 29 May 2010.

[1]
Processing
Hiss reduced by noise removal/equalisation; a beat removed near the start. Documented

These are the upload description’s claims. No unrecorded pitch correction, original horn substitutions or side cuts are inferred.

[1]
Composition rights
Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies. Inferred, not documented

Wagner died in 1883. This is a term calculation, not worldwide clearance of every edition.

[1]
Recording rights
US public domain: the record was published in December 1921. Documented

The established publication date independently supplies the US basis. This does not rely on the Commons Edison-donation template as a blanket worldwide licence.
